name: Calamity Joe
bio: "Calamity Joe" escaped a deputy at gunpoint at Rapid City and was captured in February 1886 at Glenullin by Stark County Sheriff Sebastian and Deputy Goudy. Held wounded in the Dickinson jail, he waived examination on a horse-stealing charge in March 1886 and was bound over in $1,000.
